name: Character Class
description: 5e Character Class definition detailing hit dice, saving throw proficiencies, armor/weapon proficiencies, skill choices, spellcasting, and subclasses.

hit_die.description: Hit die die type per class level (e.g. 'd10' for Fighter/Ranger, 'd6' for Wizard, 'd8' for Rogue/Cleric).

primary_ability.description: Primary ability score(s) recommended for this class (e.g. ['Strength', 'Dexterity']).

saving_throws.description: The two ability scores this class grants saving throw proficiencies in.

armor_proficiencies.description: Armor types granted by this class (e.g. ['Light armor', 'Medium armor', 'Shields']).

weapon_proficiencies.description: Weapon categories or specific weapons granted by this class.

tool_proficiencies.description: Tool kits or musical instruments proficient.

spellcasting_ability.description: Spellcasting ability score if this is a spellcasting class.

subclasses.description: Archetypes and subclasses available to this class.
